evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes img= markup payloads and parses up to five colon-delimited fields before the closing tag position supplied by RSFont.
The parsed fields enforce exact limits: image id <=100000, style/color-transform value <=511, size adjustment <=99, and optional hexadecimal colors <=0xFFFFFF.
R55 RSFont invokes this parser for ordinary inline image markup, and R360 InlineLabeledImageMarkup reuses the same parser for timg opening payloads.

The resulting spec controls Sprite transformation through rs/l/n and optional two-layer rectangle decoration around the rendered Sprite, establishing a shared image-style contract rather than an image-id parser alone.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared img/timg inline image style payload parser.

evidence.detail: The immutable record stores exactly five parsed integers: image id, sprite transform value, size adjustment and two optional RGB decoration colors.
Its helper reports two pixels of extra padding only when the first decoration color is present, matching RSFont's inline image layout and border drawing.
The object is created only by InlineImageStyleMarkup and consumed by RSFont, InlineLabeledImageMarkup and SpriteStyleTransformer paths.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for one parsed inline image style payload.

evidence.detail: The transformer creates a new Sprite with original width/height plus the parsed size adjustment, capped by a 65,536-pixel safety bound, then nearest-neighbor samples source pixels into the resized surface.

When the style transform is non-zero, nontransparent pixels are recolored through rs/l/L color math; values above 255 produce a vertical phase/gradient adjustment while lower values apply a uniform transform.
The class maintains a 128-entry four-way cache keyed by Sprite identity plus transform and size parameters, returning cached transformed Sprite instances when available.
R55 RSFont invokes this transformer for both ordinary img markup and R360 timg markup immediately before inline Sprite layout/drawing.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for cached resize/color transformation of inline text Sprites.
